summary: TSM surged +6% to $418.03 hitting fresh 52-week high after AMD's Q1 2026 blowout earnings (May 5, 2026) - revenue $10.3B, +38% YoY, beat consensus by 4%+. TSMC is AMD's primary manufacturing partner. TSMC also said 2nm capacity will grow at 70% CAGR through 2028 with 5 fabs (2 Hsinchu, 3 Kaohsiung) starting volume production this year. CEO C.C. Wei confirmed 2026 capex hitting upper end of $52-56B range. AI demand 'extremely robust'. 72% global foundry market share end of 2025.
